title: Total aircraft hydraulic failure
goal: Show the combined supply and voting-control failures required to lose hydraulic actuation.

rubric.must: The top event visibly identifies total hydraulic actuation as unavailable.
Three distinct hydraulic-system loss branches visibly combine at an AND gate.
A gate visibly marked 2/3 combines the three actuator-control channel failures.
Each hydraulic-system branch visibly has pump and reservoir-leak causes.
The supply-loss and control-vote-loss branches visibly join before the top event.
Basic-event probabilities are visibly printed next to the component failures.

ideal.notes: Updated 2026-09-14 against exemplar visual-eval/exemplars/faulttree/ideal.svg (sha256 7bffbe71b8bd). Corrected invalid relative arc in AND symbols. Exemplar green gate treatment and blue probabilities; existing gate logic retained. Visually inspected at full size and across the case family; independent targets, not engine-output snapshots.
